about: Williams Lake is a city in British Columbia’s Cariboo region, at the junction of Highways 97 and 20. A historic stampede, ranching culture, and a role as a service hub for Chilcotin and Cariboo communities define the interior plateau city. About 11,000 people live in Williams Lake.
seoSummary: Cariboo interior city at Highways 97 and 20—stampede town and service hub for Chilcotin and ranch country.
